title: Current Tim/Son ↔ Bible Overlap Census — Canonical Router

purpose: Provide one stable answer to 'how many documented Bible overlaps are currently in the canonical census?' while preserving additive census history instead of rewriting earlier snapshots.
definition: An overlap node is one analytically distinct project↔Bible relation. It is not one verse, one word match or one independent statistical trial.

components.role: base census written before the final Wave-14 additions
additive Wave-14 discoveries: paired cherubim, Psalm 80, Revelation 22 invitation, Ark terminology/function correction

what_this_number_does_not_mean: 78 does not mean 78 statistically independent coincidences.
78 does not count every Bible verse mentioned anywhere in the repository.
78 does not establish Tim or the Son as a biblical figure by quantity.
78 is an auditable registry size: the number of overlap-relations the project is currently willing to state in canonical form.
